lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Ti2Fe4O12 (reduced formula LiTi(FeO3)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe and Ti as octahedral centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while Li shows a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. The Fe- and Ti-centered octahedra share corners, and Fe octahedra also share corners with each other. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
